# Generated by the tier menu generator in the dev tools: do not edit by hand.
# The shared tier menu: pick one line in each of up to 4 groups, and the tier (up to 3) it is bought at.
# Layout interface/topbar.gui (dst_tier_menu), elements common/custom_gui/DST_tier_menu_gui.txt.
# Choosing is a draft: nothing is paid or granted until Confirm runs dst_tier_menu_finish_effect.
#
# State (country): flags dst_tier_menu_shop_<shop> (the open shop), dst_tier_menu_pending, dst_tier_menu_open;
# variables dst_tier_menu_group<G>_line = the line chosen in group G (0 = none), dst_tier_menu_group<G>_tier = its tier
# (1 to 3 while a line is chosen, else 0), dst_tier_menu_cost = the price of everything chosen.
#
# A shop <shop> supplies: <shop>_line_exists_trigger (group, line), <shop>_can_afford_trigger (dst_tier_menu_cost
# is covered), <shop>_add_price_effect (group, line, tier: adds that pick's whole price to dst_tier_menu_cost),
# <shop>_grant_effect (group, line, tier: the reward), <shop>_finish_effect (pays dst_tier_menu_cost and settles),
# <shop>_ai_pick_effect (raises at most one group through dst_tier_menu_ai_raise_effect). No square brackets anywhere
# in this file.

# Country scope: open shop $shop$ from scratch. A human gets the window, the AI chooses and confirms at once
dst_tier_menu_open_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_$shop$
		set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_pending
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group2_line
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group2_tier
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_cost
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai = no
			}
			set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_open
		}
		else = {
			dst_tier_menu_ai_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: a line button. Picks line $line$ for group $group$ (at tier I if the group had no pick),
# or drops it if it already is the pick
dst_tier_menu_pick_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
					value = $line$
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
				value = 0
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
				value = $line$
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
							value = 1
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
					value = 1
				}
			}
		}
		dst_tier_menu_update_effect = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: a tier box. Sets group $group$ to tier $tier$ (one box is ticked: the tier); clicking the ticked
# box drops the line
dst_tier_menu_tier_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
					value = $tier$
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
				value = 0
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
				value = $tier$
			}
		}
		dst_tier_menu_update_effect = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: recount dst_tier_menu_cost from the open shop's prices

# Country scope: the Confirm button. Every chosen line is granted, the shop pays and settles up, the state is cleared
dst_tier_menu_finish_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 1 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 1 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 1 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
					value = 2
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 2 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 2 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 1 line = 2 tier = 3 }

			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line

						value = 1
					}
				}

			}
		}

			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group2_line
					value = 2
				}
			}
			if = {

						which = dst_tier_menu_group2_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 2 line = 2 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {

			}

					}

				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 1 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
					value = 2

			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 2 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 2 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 2 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
					value = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 3 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 3 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 3 line = 3 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
					value = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 1 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 1 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 1 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
					value = 2
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 2 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 2 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 2 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_variable_equal = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
					value = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 1
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 3 tier = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 2
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 3 tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_variable_equal = {
						which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
						value = 3
					}
				}
				maz_coronation_grant_effect = { group = 4 line = 3 tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		maz_coronation_finish_effect = yes
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		dst_tier_menu_reset_effect = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: clear the window state without settling anything
dst_tier_menu_reset_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_open
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_pending
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_bought
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g1
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g2
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g3
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g4
	clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group1_line
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group1_tier
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group2_line
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group2_tier
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group3_line
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group3_tier
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group4_line
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_cost
		value = 0
	}
}

# Country scope (AI): raise group $group$ one tier on line $line$. If the shop can no longer afford it, take it back
# and mark the group full (dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g<G>), so the shop moves on. Sets dst_tier_menu_ai_bought either way
dst_tier_menu_ai_raise_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
				value = 3
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g$group$
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
			value = $line$
		}
		change_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
			value = 1
		}
		dst_tier_menu_update_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					dst_tier_menu_can_afford_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			subtract_variable = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
				value = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_tier
							value = 1
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_group$group$_line
					value = 0
				}
			}
			dst_tier_menu_update_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_full_g$group$
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_bought
}

# Country scope (AI): let the shop raise one group at a time until it finds nothing more, at most 16 times,
# then confirm
dst_tier_menu_ai_effect = {
	set_variable = {
		which = dst_tier_menu_ai_count
		value = 0
	}
	set_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_bought
	while = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_bought
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					which = dst_tier_menu_ai_count
					value = 16
				}
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_ai_bought
		change_variable = {
			which = dst_tier_menu_ai_count
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_shop_maz_coronation
			}
			maz_coronation_ai_pick_effect = yes
		}
	}
	dst_tier_menu_finish_effect = yes
}
